item.text:
Reconstructed **عید کی بھیک** in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both versions have five stanzas of four verses. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read `Khiarat` as خیرات and `Aane Do Aane` as آنے دو آنے, referring to one or two annas. Only the selected lyric was edited.
